Its most substantial internal reuse occurs with the commentary to the Theragāthā (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo), involving nine shared segments, most notably between segments 3.1–3.3 of the *Ekañjalikattheraapadāna* and segments 1626–1627 of the commentary [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, recurring stock verses or formulaic lines connect segments 3.3–7.1 with several other poems in the Therāpadāna, including the *Avopupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 64), *Ārakkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 226), *Ākāsukkhipiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 263), *Ekasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 77), *Abyādhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 227), and *Ñāṇasaññikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 130) [DharmaNexus].
